editorial.description_en: Stubble left standing after the cut — the same field as rice ear, a week later and much quieter.
editorial.description_ja: 刈ったあとの田のような、しずんだ黄土。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.700, C 0.072, h 76.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 刈り (kari, cutting) + 跡 (ato, what is left behind). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "After the Harvest" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 刈跡. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — kare-no at ΔE00 6.0, asa-bukuro at ΔE00 6.7, hi-kabe at ΔE00 7.0. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (256°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
